description.value: Land & Sea Brewing Co. is a community-focused craft brewery and tasting room in Comox, BC, opened in December 2018 as the third craft brewery in the Comox Valley. The bright, welcoming space seats 70 guests indoors around an open kitchen, with a patio for 40 more on sunny days, and the brewery explicitly encourages cyclists to visit — calling it out in their parking policy alongside transit and walking. In-house craft beers are complemented by rotating BC guest taps and a small in-house food menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is detailed and current, confirming the address, phone, and email from OSM. The website's Code of Conduct/Parking section explicitly describes dedicated bike parking for up to 6 bikes plus railing space, and actively encourages guests to cycle to the venue. The OSM record name 'Land & Sea Tasting Room' differs from the business's consistent self-identification as 'Land & Sea Brewing Co.' throughout the website (also reflected in the OSM name:en tag), which is flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name is 'Land & Sea Tasting Room' but the business consistently uses 'Land & Sea Brewing Co.' on its website and in its footer; the OSM name:en tag also reflects 'Land & Sea Brewing Co.' — OSM primary name tag may warrant correction.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Actively cycling-friendly craft brewery in Comox with dedicated bike parking for 6+ bikes, explicit encouragement for cyclists in their parking policy, dine-in food and drink, and takeout — a strong fit for the WWC directory.

Bike parking or bike visibility.detail: Website describes 'plenty of railing space for additional bikes' beyond the 6 dedicated spots

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Gluten-free beer explicitly listed on the beer menu: 'Whistler Forager Lager - 375ml / 5% ABV'. No explicit mention of vegetarian or vegan food options in the available website content
